about: What this file is: the shot check for the Works' view W4 (inside No. 2's yard, page 14) (paper-film/blender/inflation-chapter-2-newcomers/works/assemble_works.py, plan 34 part 1 'A. The Works'): which objects make up each prop and figure, their parts in the story, the lane's direction, where the typed words go. Round 5: W4's corner on No. 2's inner pier (the jacket on its peg, the crate table with the cap, the mug and the WAGES envelope, the upturned crate by the hinge), the back of the No. 2 board lettered, the gateway crates left out of W4 (so they are not listed). Each waiting man is his own group, so the checker counts them; in the film they are dark own-surface silhouettes seen through the bars. Used by paper-film/blender/shot_facts.py and paper-film/tools/check_shot.py; run from the kit's top folder with BLEND=assets/models/inflation-chapter-2-newcomers/works/works-lane.blend paper-film/tools/check-shot.sh paper-film/blender/inflation-chapter-2-newcomers/works/assemble_works.py THIS_FILE OUT [PICTURE] -- --view w4.
